protocol.purpose: Timing-bound sensitivity only; fixed nominal detector, K, knots and raw targets
protocol.choice_reason: Narrower and wider nested neighborhoods around the existing nominal setting, selected before new fits; not tuned for best results
protocol.objective: Raw XYZ position least squares, no opposition penalty
protocol.initialization: Identical boundary extension .25 for start 0; same normalized random draws for starts 1..3, mapped into each feasible box
protocol.scope: 18-21 s K4 and 30-33 s K3 only; not all count partitions, filter settings, full clip or multiple subjects
protocol.selection: Lowest position RMSE among successful endpoint-valid fits; no replacing nominal setting by whichever setting scores best
